title: Sci-Fi
story: Blast off into the stars with the icons of space-adventure movies.

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A silver rocket with a pointed red nose cone, three fins at the base and a round porthole window.
cards.hero_colors: silver, white, red nose and fins, small yellow flame

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A round silver flying saucer with a glass dome on top and a ring of small lights around the rim.
cards.hero_colors: silver, light blue glass dome, small orange lights

cards.name: Robot
cards.subject: A boxy friendly robot with a square head, two antennae, round eyes, two arms and two legs.
cards.hero_colors: light gray, white, small red button

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round white space helmet with a large curved gold visor and a collar ring.
cards.hero_colors: white, gold visor, small blue accent

cards.name: Ray Planet
cards.subject: A ringed planet with a round orange body and a tilted flat ring around it.
cards.hero_colors: orange, cream ring, small purple stripe

cards.name: Alien Pet
cards.subject: A small green alien creature with a round body, two antennae, three eyes and four short legs.

cards.name: Space Station
cards.subject: A space station with a round central hub, a long tube body and four large blue solar panels.
cards.hero_colors: white, gray, blue panels, small red light
cards.surface_or_setting: bright starry space with a blue planet

cards.name: Time Machine
cards.subject: A round time machine pod with a curved glass door, a ring of lights around the frame and three short legs.
cards.hero_colors: silver, teal glass, small orange lights

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A six-wheeled moon rover with an open cabin, a small dish antenna and a flat body.
cards.hero_colors: white, gray wheels, small yellow dish
cards.surface_or_setting: gray moon surface with craters and bright sky

cards.name: Control Panel
cards.subject: A slanted control console with a row of round buttons, two levers and a small round screen.
cards.hero_colors: dark gray, light blue screen, small red buttons
